title: remote-fixture-project
responsibility: Owns the remote-fixture-project build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: fixtureImage.size
inputs.description: The side length in pixels of the square picture that fixtureImage draws, which matters when a caller needs a size other than the default 96 (the generator in fixtureProviders asks for 128). The code does not validate it, so a non-whole or non-positive value is passed to the PNG encoder as given.

inputs.name: fixtureImage.variant
inputs.description: The tint of the picture, which matters when a copy must differ from the original: its blue value is 160 + 9 * variant, so 0 is the original picture. The code does not range-check it, and a blue value outside 0 to 255 wraps around, which happens for whole variants above 10 or below -17.

outputs.name: fixtureImage
outputs.description: The PNG file bytes of the gradient picture for the given size and variant; remoteFixtureProject stores the default-size picture as its design image. Each call encodes a new picture, and nothing is cached.

outputs.name: remoteFixtureProject
outputs.description: An object giving the absolute path of a new temporary Git repository (root), the id of its one planned page (entityId) and the id of a thread opened on that page (threadId). Each call creates a new repository under the OS temp directory, with a design image for the page, and the code never removes it.

outputs.name: fixtureProviders
outputs.description: The synthetic runners for codex and claude plus an image generator; they start no process and change no file. Each runner's discover reports one available model and its run returns a canned answer after about 1.2 seconds, while the generator's generateImage returns a 128-pixel fixture picture whose variant starts at 0 and rises by one with each call.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown by the run method of each runner from fixtureProviders when the turn's signal is aborted once its 1.2-second wait ends; it is the RunCancelled class, an Error with the message 'The run was cancelled.'

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Passed through from remoteFixtureProject, which has no try/catch, so a failing git command (execFileSync throws on a non-zero exit), a file-system call, or a project-session or planning call rejects with that call's own Error.
